Cooked food and special garb won't help you.|Tips and Tricks|TotK}}{{Name Ref|EoW}} ==Locations and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Cold Water is a variety of [[Water (Terrain)|Water]] found in [[Freezing Climate]]s throughout [[Hyrule]]. If [[Link]] [[Swimming|Swims]] in Cold Water, he will start to take damage at a rate of half a [[Heart]] every 0.5 seconds. [[Frozen Food]]s can also be made by dropping [[Fish]] and [[Meat]] into Cold Water.{{Cite|{{Big|Freezing Climates}}
Some ingredients will freeze if submerged in ice-cold water or when left out in frigid regions. There are a few ingredients that taste even better frozen.|Tips and Tricks|BotW}} ====Locations==== The following bodies of Water contain Cold Water: {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center; width:60%;" |- !style="width:30%"| Location !style="width:30%"| Region |- | [[Hebra Falls]] | [[Tabantha Frontier]] |- | [[Hebra Headspring]] | [[Tabantha Frontier]] |- | [[Hebra Plunge]] | [[Tabantha Frontier]] |- | [[River of the Dead]] | [[Great Plateau]] |} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==={{EoW|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= EoW |type= Enemies |category= Enemies in Echoes of Wisdom |needs= Detailed information on the following: * The Enemy's behavior * The Enemy's weaknesses * Where the Enemy appears * What the Echo cost is for the Enemy }} {{Stub|EoW}} Cold Water is a type of frigid [[Water (Terrain)|Water]] found in the [[Freezing Climate]] of [[Hebra Mountain]] and in [[Stilled Holy Mount Lanayru]]. When [[Swimming|Swam]] in, Cold Water takes away a quarter of a [[Heart]] from [[Princess Zelda]]'s [[Life Gauge]] every two seconds. This can be mitigated with the [[Chill-Proof]] or [[Ice-Proof]] [[Added Effect]]s. When [[Water Block]]s are placed atop Cold Water and left there for two seconds, they will freeze into [[Ice Block]]s. Cold Water cannot be [[Learning|Learned]] as an [[Echo]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Freezing Climate * Water (Terrain) }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Waters |enemies= EoW |objects= BotW, TotK }}
